description: Update Android build.gradle to remove React Native dependencies. Remove react-native autolinking, Hermes engine config, Expo prebuild settings from android/build.gradle and android/app/build.gradle. Delete MainActivity.kt (React Native entry), clean up Android manifest to remove RN activities. Update dependencies to pure Kotlin/Compose only. Test Gradle build with clean configuration.
